name: JWH-019
summary: JWH-019 is an analgesic chemical from the naphthoylindole family that acts as a cannabinoid agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors. It is the N-hexyl homolog of the more common synthetic cannabinoid compound JWH-018.

pharmacology.text: JWH-019 is an analgesic chemical from the naphthoylindole family that acts as a cannabinoid agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors.

summaryZh: JWH-019，化學名1-己基-3-(1-萘甲醯基)吲哚（英語：1-hexyl-3-indole），分子式C25H25NO，屬於萘甲醯基吲哚類JWH系列大麻素，可作為鎮痛藥。
